dedupe_keys.name: space4climate satellite climate indicators and portals for pakistan suparco

description: Space4Climate is the platform of SUPARCO, the Pakistan space agency, for understanding, monitoring, mitigating and adapting to climate change with satellite intelligence. Its home page shows national climate indicators from satellite observations: annual methane and carbon dioxide levels over Pakistan, and monthly aerosol optical depth, nitrogen dioxide and sulphur dioxide levels, each with a trend and an explanation, plus provincial and city views. Climate portals cover the environment (air pollutants and greenhouse gases in near real time), forestry (annual forest cover, biomass and disturbance alerts), glaciers (extent, velocity and proglacial lake monitoring for glacial lake outburst flood alerting), coastal dynamics (shoreline change and mangrove health), waterways (river migration, encroachment and basin monitoring) and land cover and agriculture, and the page posts updates such as GLOF monitoring status reports. Related links include the DISASTERWATCH service and a NatCat model. Access is free and public online; the site states all rights reserved and gives no open licence. Caveats: a disclaimer says the satellite values represent broad areas and cannot be used directly as local air quality index values. Coverage is Pakistan. It supports hazard exposure analysis for floods and glacial lake outbursts near roads, bridges and hydropower, and climate adaptation planning; related records are the PhilSA Space Data Dashboard and the MYSA open data catalogue.
